properties.address: Land off Delamere Road, Ashton Hayes
properties.summary:
This approximately 10.25-acre (4.14 hectare) plot on the outskirts of Mouldsworth comprises gently undulating grassland, a centrally positioned pond and a timber-framed agricultural building measuring around 14.4m by 7.2m. The building includes open-fronted bays, a workshop, storage and a mezzanine, and offers scope for improvement. Several smaller timber sheds are also present.

The land is well fenced with post and rail and mature hedgerows, and is close to Delamere Forest and its extensive bridleways, including the 35km Delamere Loop. The sale is subject to a 30-year development clawback, under which 30% of any value uplift from non-agricultural or equestrian planning permission would be payable to the sellers or their successors.
